'''Do'naal''' was a bearded [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. While appearing to be loyal to the Alliance, he was in fact an [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] mole, responsible for compromising the identities of several Rebel agents including [[Vewin]] on [[Kelada/Legends|Kelada]], and [[Rixen]] on [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]].<ref name="DED">{{WEGCite|story=Dead End Drop|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref>
